test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All buds are flowers.

All insects are flowers.

Conclusions:

(I) All buds are insects.

(II) All flowers are buds.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40d8e647f74e8ea92c3f5da5299df566bb5f7b034740381775292c85715618cd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a84f6028bf65ce473d028526baa4b61abc0bf2862d4518782f7107ff128e51dd.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All buds are insects → Does not follow (As all buds are flowers and all insects are flowers. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) All flowers are buds → Does not follow (As all buds are flowers. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
